cues.label: 02 · Delivery and business effects have different identities

blocks.text: ЭКРАН. Раздел «Delivery and business effects have different identities». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Northstar receives appointment-status events from its scheduling service. An event identifier names a particular message. A business operation identifier names the action that message represents. A replay position tells a subscriber where it is in a stream. These values may be related, but they are not interchangeable. A publisher can send the same business operation again as a new event after a timeout. Deduplicating only the event identifier would not recognize that second message as the same operation. Conversely, two valid updates to the same appointment are not duplicates merely because they share an appointment Id. Define the unit you intend to apply once.

cues.label: 03 · Choose a version policy that matches the payload

blocks.text: ЭКРАН. Раздел «Choose a version policy that matches the payload». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

The synthetic events below carry a complete current status and a monotonically increasing version assigned by the authoritative scheduling system. Under that explicit contract, version 3 can replace version 1, and a later arrival of version 2 should not move the appointment backward. The version is scoped to one appointment; it does not order all activity across every dealer. A delta event, such as 'increase reserved capacity by one,' needs different treatment. Skipping an earlier delta because a higher version arrived can lose part of the calculation. Do not reuse the snapshot-state policy without checking the payload meaning. You may need ordered processing, gap detection, or reconciliation with the source.

cues.label: 04 · Make the state change and deduplication durable

blocks.text: ЭКРАН. Раздел «Make the state change and deduplication durable». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

An in-memory Set disappears when the worker restarts. For effects that must survive a restart, use durable state: for example, an operation ledger or a stored source version with a suitable uniqueness and concurrency strategy. If two workers can race, a check-then-insert sequence without protection can allow both to act. Explain where uniqueness or transaction coordination closes that gap. When both the ledger update and the business update occur inside one Salesforce transaction, they can be designed to commit or fail together. A remote email or external reservation is outside that local database transaction. Its own idempotency key, acknowledgment, and recovery contract are still necessary. A Salesforce rollback cannot unsend a remote message already accepted elsewhere.
